answer.text: Listed stocks, listed bonds, open-ended MF units, ETFs

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Table 1.1, traditional investments = listed stocks, listed bonds, open-ended MFs, ETFs. The Trap: Other options are alternative investments. Cross-Exam Context: Clear distinction per the workbook. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Start with traditional investments in any client overview before introducing alternatives.
